description: This Java class implements a simple audio output mechanism using Android's AudioTrack API, providing methods for creating, starting, stopping, and writing audio data to output.

classes.name: SimpleAudioOutput
classes.description: A helper class for managing audio output via AudioTrack, allowing start, stop, and data write operations.

methods.name: SimpleAudioOutput
methods.description: Constructor for creating an instance of SimpleAudioOutput.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and starts the audio output at the specified frame rate.

methods.name: createAudioTrack
methods.description: Creates and configures an AudioTrack object with appropriate buffer sizes for streaming audio.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Writes a buffer of float audio data to the AudioTrack for playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops playback and releases resources associated with the AudioTrack.

methods.name: getFrameRate
methods.description: Returns the current frame rate used for playback.
